# Container

`layout/container` &middot; section-level &middot; category: layout

## Purpose

A narrower, centered content column inside the email width, for text that reads better at a shorter line length.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `content` | components (content-level) |  |

## Optional fields

None.

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: 480px reading column.
- **narrow**: 400px column for short, focused messages. Sets `maxWidth: 400px`.
- **wide**: 540px column. Sets `maxWidth: 540px`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `maxWidth` | length | `"480px"` |
| `paddingY` | length | `"@theme.section.paddingY"` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Honored, it is section padding. | Fine. | Swaps via dm-* classes when on the brand surface or background color. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('layout/container', {
  "content": [
    {
      "component": "content/heading",
      "data": {
        "text": "A note from our founder"
      },
      "settings": {
        "level": "h2"
      }
    },
    {
      "component": "content/text",
      "data": {
        "text": "We started with one workshop and a simple idea: make the things you use every day last longer. Thank you for being part of the first thousand orders."
      }
    }
  ]
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "layout/container",
  "data": {
    "content": [
      {
        "component": "content/heading",
        "data": {
          "text": "A note from our founder"
        },

          "level": "h2"
        }
      },
      {
        "component": "content/text",
        "data": {
          "text": "We started with one workshop and a simple idea: make the things you use every day last longer. Thank you for being part of the first thousand orders."
        }
      }
    ]
  }
```
